provenance.provider_boundary: Only Places suggestions are injected. Actual controller, middleware, service, rate store and serializer execute; no external provider calls.

normalized_clock_fields.server_now: verified between actual dispatch start/end before replacement
normalized_clock_fields.event(s).created_at/updated_at/checked_a: exact stored equality and bounded runtime clocks before replacement
normalized_clock_fields.event(s).start_at/end_at/next_reverify_a: exact stored equality then shift from capture epoch; null estimated editor end preserved
normalized_clock_fields.event(s).start_local/end_local and facts: verify stored IANA conversion, then recompute for shifted schedule in the same timezone (including DST)
normalized_clock_fields.activities[].created_at/updated_at/start: exact stored equality; runtime clocks replaced and event schedule shifted

normalized_identifier_fields.external_event_id/activity_id: persisted full external identity and bidirectional cross-links checked before stable prefix mapping
normalized_identifier_fields.audit_id: real stored actor/action/target/reason/revision, receipt and exact counts checked before mapping
normalized_identifier_fields.sources[].source_id: exact equality with the bounded stored source before mapping
normalized_identifier_fields.thread_id/message_id: stored official system message, activity/thread cross-links, sequence/text/pin and absent member sender verified before mapping

provenance.additional_console_capture: Existing activity detail/lifecycle, configuration and hostless moderation use the actual routes, audited transactions and completed receipts. Case/report intake is synthetic; evidence uses the production immutable writer. P1 member report intake is not claimed by this admin corpus.
provenance.external_chat_capture: The shared chat scenario uses actual member session middleware, sends, author withdrawal, Webadmin queue/detail/audited evidence/claim/resolve and completed receipts. No message or prepublication case is fabricated. Persisted opaque IDs and bounded clocks only are normalized; emitted order, text, state, revisions and decisions are unchanged.
provenance.external_variety_capture: Old128 admin bodies remain independently byte-pinned. Shared actual audited/receipted Router publisher and member/chat writers produce sports, paid (price/ticket/age), sensitive count-only and America/Los_Angeles list/detail reads. Stored facts, paired IDs/CAS, venue, sources and Core IANA local strings are checked before opaque-ID and bounded/reference-clock normalization. Trailing NBSP organizer, counts, state, capabilities and emitted order/text are preserved. Ordinary threads, older-activity viewer hides and accepted photo metadata are explicit synthetic reader preconditions; no successful mutation or provider result is fabricated.
